title: 30x30 Biodiversity Assessment Explorer
live_note: Results for this area are computed live from the source data; larger areas can take a minute or two.
land_cells: SELECT DISTINCT e.h0, e.h8, e.h9, e.h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') e JOIN ({{AOI10}}) a ON e.h0 = a.h0 AND e.h10 = a.h10
land: SELECT c.h0, c.h8, c.h9, c.h10, h3_cell_area(c.h10, 'km^2') AS area_km2, COALESCE(w.w1 + w.w2, 0) AS w12, COALESCE(w.w3 + w.w4, 0) AS w34 FROM ({{CELLS}}) c LEFT JOIN read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/conserved-areas-terrestrial-2025/hex-weights/h0=*/data_0.parquet') w ON w.h0 = c.h0 AND w.h10 = c.h10

statewide.label: California
statewide.description: The whole state, as in the report
statewide.aoi10: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8, h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
statewide.cells: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8, h9, h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')

reference.label: Report
reference.title: Published in the 2025 Biodiversity Assessment
reference.citation: Schloss, C., Howard, J., Olliff Yang, R., et al. (2026). California’s 30x30 Initiative in 2025: A Biodiversity Assessment of the State’s 30x30 Conservation Areas. California Biodiversity Network.
reference.note: Features, thresholds and the representation framework follow

jurisdictions.label: Ecoregions
jurisdictions.description: The 20 ecoregions used by California's 30x30 initiative and the 2025 Biodiversity Assessment
jurisdictions.aoi: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE CA_Ecoregi = '{{ID}}'
jurisdictions.aoi10: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8, h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE CA_Ecoregi = '{{ID}}'
jurisdictions.list: SELECT CA_Ecoregi AS id, CA_Ecoregi AS name, MIN(ST_XMin(geom)) AS xmin, MIN(ST_YMin(geom)) AS ymin, MAX(ST_XMax(geom)) AS xmax, MAX(ST_YMax(geom)) AS ymax FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion.parquet') GROUP BY CA_Ecoregi ORDER BY CA_Ecoregi

jurisdictions.label: Counties
jurisdictions.aoi: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-census/census-2024/county/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE STATEFP = '06' AND GEOID = '{{ID}}'
jurisdictions.aoi10: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8, h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-census/census-2024/tract/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE STATEFP = '06' AND GEOID LIKE '{{ID}}%'
jurisdictions.list: SELECT GEOID AS id, NAMELSAD AS name, ST_XMin(geom) AS xmin, ST_YMin(geom) AS ymin, ST_XMax(geom) AS xmax, ST_YMax(geom) AS ymax FROM read_parquet('s3://public-census/census-2024/county.parquet') WHERE STATEFP = '06' ORDER BY NAME
